text:
Tess H.: Big news — promoted to Senior PM and expecting a baby in Sept! :party_popper: Potluck celebration next Friday at 12:30? No pressure, just a small gathering.
Omar: Congratulations!!! :tada: I'll bring a sandwich tray and paper plates.
Sophia: Amazing!! So happy for you both.
Grace: Congrats! I can coordinate with People Ops for the promo announcement and bring GF brownies.
Liam: Cake? Yes. When does the promotion take effect?
Julie: Cupcakes + vegan option from my place. Also I can make a simple banner.
DeployBot: Reminder: kitchen cleanup scheduled Sun 8pm — please label food. :fridge:
Tess H.: Promo takes effect Mon. Thanks everyone. I'll send calendar invite and a tiny registry link tomorrow. Love the banner idea :confetti_ball:
Omar: I'll pick up a banner and a small bouquet. Do we want balloons?
Sophia: Neutral + gold balloons? Playlist recs: "Good as Hell", "Celebrate".
Grace: I'll handle labels for dietary restrictions.
Liam: Adding tentative event to calendar. I'll queue chill -> upbeat playlist. Drop more song recs.
Julie: Song recs: "Lovely Day", "Walking on Sunshine". Also bringing disposable cutlery.
Tess H.: You all are the best. See you Friday! :smiling_face_with_3_hearts:
